name: Diverse Recommendations
description: Users want a more diverse music library with less repetitive recommendations. They feel that the current algorithm fails to offer fresh, relevant music, often recycling the same small library of tracks.

name: Intuitive Discovery UI
description: Users need a simplified and intuitive user interface for music discovery. They find the current design confusing, with too many buttons and cluttered sections, creating a high cognitive load during the discovery process.

name: Accurate Recommendation
description: Users want a more accurate song recommendation system that matches their taste. They feel that the current system often recommends songs that don't align with their preferences, leading to a disappointing experience.

name: Transparent Recommendation
description: Users desire transparency in the recommendation algorithm, wanting to know why certain songs are suggested. They feel that the lack of transparency leads to mistrust and frustration with the app.

name: Effortless Music Exploration
description: Users need an effortless way to explore and discover new music, without excessive friction or complexity. They want to easily find and play songs that match their mood or preferences, without being overwhelmed by the app's interface.
